flows.title: Share a file or folder with people
steps: On dropbox.com, hover over the file or folder and click Share.
Type the email, name or group of each person, then select them from the results.
Select can edit or can view, and add a message if you like.

flows.title: Create a folder
steps: On dropbox.com, click New folder under the search bar at the top.
Under Name, enter a name for the folder.
Select who has access: Only you or Only specific people.

flows.title: Upload files or a folder
steps: On dropbox.com, click Upload under the search bar at the top.
For files, select as many as you like, then click Open.
For a folder, select it, then click Upload.
